title: "normalize_families"
output: html_document

---



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This script normalizes all unique species range maps by family across land, air, and ocean
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------



```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(move2)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(tidyterra) 
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggspatial)
```


```{r}
#get masks ready
land_mask <- ne_download(scale= "medium", type = "land", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")

r_template <- rast(xmin = -180, xmax = 180, ymin = -90, ymax = 90, resolution =1, crs = "EPSG:4326")

land_vect <- vect(land_mask )
land_rast <- rasterize(land_vect, r_template, field = 1, touches = TRUE)

ocean_mask <- ne_download(scale= "medium", type = "ocean", category = "physical", returnclass = "sf")


ocean_vect <- vect(ocean_mask )
ocean_rast <- rasterize(ocean_vect, r_template, field = 1, touches = TRUE)



```



Create normalization rasters based on family

```{r}
#use the mollweide family directory and out directory or the esri 4326 paths for different analyses


# fam_direct <- "family_maps/mollweide"
# out_norm_direct <- "normalized/mollweide"
fam_direct <- "family_maps/esri_4326"
out_norm_direct <- "normalized/esri_4326"


if (grepl("esri_4326", fam_direct)){
  out_end <- "4326"
} else {
  out_end <- "moll"
}

fam_list <- list.files(fam_direct, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)

# Bat families in the data
bat_families <- c("Pteropodidae", "Phyllostomidae", "Vespertilionidae", 
                  "Molossidae", "Emballonuridae", "Megadermatidae",
                  "Rhinolophidae", "Myzopodidae", "Noctilionidae")


# Seal families (Pinnipeds)
seal_families <- c("Odobenidae", "Otariidae", "Phocidae")

# Amphibious/Marine Reptiles & Turtles
amphibious_families <- c("Cheloniidae", "Dermochelyidae", "Crocodylidae", "Emydidae")


# Align masks
target_crs <- crs(rast(fam_list[1]))
land_mask <- st_transform(land_mask, target_crs)
ocean_mask <- st_transform(ocean_mask, target_crs)

# Build dataframe
family_df <- data.frame(
  full_path = fam_list,
  base_name = basename(fam_list),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(family_name = sub("\\_.*", "", base_name)) %>% 
  mutate(family_expression = sub("^.*?\\_","", base_name)) %>%
  mutate(family_expression = sub("\\.tif.*", '', family_expression)) 

# Create a "terrestrial_no_bats" group for a separate analysis
no_bats_df <- family_df %>%
  filter(family_expression == "terrestrial") %>%
  filter(!family_name %in% bat_families) %>% 
  mutate(family_expression = "terrestrial_no_bats") 

# 2. Create the Appendix group: No bats, No Seals, and No Amphibious for a separate analysis
appendix_df <- family_df %>%
  filter(family_expression == "terrestrial") %>%
  filter(!family_name %in% c(bat_families, seal_families, amphibious_families)) %>% 
  mutate(family_expression = "terrestrial_supp_no_amphib") 

# Bind extra analyses tags together 
family_df <- bind_rows(family_df, no_bats_df, appendix_df)
all_expressions <- unique(family_df$family_expression)



#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalization Loop
#---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

for (ex in all_expressions){
  cat("\nProcessing group:", ex ,"\n")
  ex_df <- family_df %>% filter(family_expression == ex)
  
  # Determine which mask to use based on analysis
  if(str_detect(tolower(ex), "terrestrial")){
    active_mask <- land_mask
  } else if(str_detect(tolower(ex), "marine")){
    active_mask <- ocean_mask
  } else {
    active_mask <- NULL
  }
  
  # Load rasters
  exp_rasters <- lapply(ex_df$full_path, rast)
  
  # --- PREPARE RAW LAYERS (For Richness) ---
  raw_layers <- lapply(exp_rasters, function(rast_layer){
    if(!is.null(active_mask)) rast_layer <- mask(rast_layer, active_mask)
    classify(rast_layer, cbind(NA, 0)) # Convert NAs to 0s for math
  })
  raw_stack <- rast(raw_layers)

  # SPECIES RICHNESS (Sum of raw counts)

  species_richness <- app(raw_stack, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
  if(!is.null(active_mask)) species_richness <- mask(species_richness, active_mask)
  
  out_path_species <- file.path(out_norm_direct, paste0(ex,"_species_richness_", out_end, "touches.tif"))
  writeRaster(species_richness, out_path_species, overwrite = TRUE)
  cat("   Saved Species Richness\n")
  

  #  NORMALIZED SPECIES RICHNESS (0 to 1)

  sr_max <- global(species_richness, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
  sr_min <- global(species_richness, fun = "min", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
  
  if(!is.na(sr_max) && sr_max != sr_min) {
    species_richness_norm <- (species_richness - sr_min) / (sr_max - sr_min)
  } else {
    species_richness_norm <- species_richness * 0 
  }
  
  out_path_sr_norm <- file.path(out_norm_direct, paste0(ex,"_species_richness_normalized_", out_end, "touches.tif"))
  writeRaster(species_richness_norm, out_path_sr_norm, overwrite = TRUE)



  # FAMILY RICHNESS (Count of families present)

  family_presence_stack <- raw_stack > 0 
  family_richness <- app(family_presence_stack, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
  if(!is.null(active_mask)) family_richness <- mask(family_richness, active_mask)
  
  out_path_family <- file.path(out_norm_direct, paste0(ex,"_family_richness_", out_end, "touches.tif"))
  writeRaster(family_richness, out_path_family, overwrite = TRUE)



  # NORMALIZED MEAN (0 to 1)

  normalized_layers <- lapply(raw_layers, function(rast_layer){
    max_value <- global(rast_layer, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
    min_value <- global(rast_layer, fun = "min", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
    
    if(is.na(max_value) || max_value == min_value) return(rast_layer * 0) 
    (rast_layer - min_value) / (max_value - min_value)
  })
  
  normalized_stack <- rast(normalized_layers)
  mean_eval <- mean(normalized_stack, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  final_max <- global(mean_eval, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
  final_min <- global(mean_eval, fun = "min", na.rm = TRUE)[1,1]
  
  if(!is.na(final_max) && final_max != final_min) {
    mean_eval <- (mean_eval - final_min) / (final_max - final_min)
  }
  
  if(!is.null(active_mask)) mean_eval <- mask(mean_eval, active_mask)
  
  out_path_mean <- file.path(out_norm_direct, paste0(ex,"_normalized_mean_01_", out_end, "touches.tif"))
  writeRaster(mean_eval, out_path_mean, overwrite = TRUE)

}
```
